objects.name: Sergeant Maelis
lines: Broken Guard. We rake the sand, we carry the fallen out, we mind the drains.
Our great-great-grandmothers guarded a prince. We guard a pit. Family tradition, of a sort.

answer: Three hundred years of names. We cross them out when they fall. It's the only writing we're allowed.
The newest line's blank. Try not to make me cross you out. I've a steady hand, but I'd rather not.
His captain wrote him down as lost in action. Not deserter. Lost.
My family's kept that word for five hundred years. Lost things can be found.
The north drain runs under the wall toward the maze. Hugo found something in it once. He won't say what. Gardeners.

lines: The fight card, chalked fresh every day: BRING A FIGHTER OR BRING IRON.
A smaller line at the bottom: CHEERING IS COMPULSORY.

intro.speaker: Barnaby Loudmouth
lines: HEAR YE! In this corner: a stranger! And their very large, very nervous friend!
In the other corner: THREE OF THE KING'S OWN! FIGHT!
